title: ActiveMQ Classic driver
text: STOMP 1.2 over TCP; requeue is re-send plus ACK and may duplicate; no consumer groups; buffer_limit defaults to 10000.

title: ActiveMQ Artemis driver
text: STOMP 1.2 over TCP; NACK is a discard; consumers must subscribe first; buffer_limit defaults to 10000.

title: Beanstalkd driver
text: Beanstalkd text protocol; ack, requeue and delay; no headers, key or batch publishing; unacked messages return after TTR.

title: NATS Core driver
text: At-most-once core NATS; subscribe before publishing; ack and reject unsupported; queue_group for groups; JetStream not implemented.

title: NSQ driver
text: NSQ v2 TCP; the channel must exist first; no delay, TLS or AUTH; published messages carry no id.

title: Redis Streams driver
text: RESP2; consumer groups and XACK; reject(true) unsupported, recover from the PEL with XAUTOCLAIM; no delay or TLS.

title: Azure Service Bus driver
text: REST data-plane with SAS; peek-lock; no AMQP, OAuth or transactions; entities must exist; delay resolution is one second.

title: GCP Pub/Sub driver
text: REST JSON with service-account JWT; one-message pull; ack deadline default 60 seconds; at-least-once; topics must exist.

title: AWS Kinesis driver
text: JSON API plus SigV4; shard checkpoint in memory; no requeue or dead-letter queue; no headers or delay.

title: AWS SNS driver
text: Query API plus SigV4; publish only; receive and publishBatch unsupported; no FIFO topics or MessageStructure json.

title: AWS SQS driver
text: JSON plus SigV4; ack, requeue, delay and long polling; FIFO per-message delay unsupported; bodies must be UTF-8.

title: RabbitMQ driver
text: AMQP 0-9-1; default exchange only; no publisher confirms; one connection and channel; no delay or auto-delete.

title: ZeroMQ driver
text: ZMTP 3.1 with PUB/SUB and PUSH/PULL; at-most-once; slow joiner; no persistence, ack, TLS or reconnect.

title: Kafka family driver
text: Kafka wire protocol with Redpanda, AutoMQ, Confluent and Event Hubs aliases; offset commit and seek; no SASL or transactions.

title: Pulsar driver
text: Binary protocol v11; Shared subscriptions; ack, requeue and delay around one second; experimental; no auth, batching or schema.

title: RocketMQ driver
text: 4.x remoting; publish, pull, ack, requeue and delay levels; experimental; no transactions, ACL, TAG filtering or compression.
